accounting_policy.gross: All36 whole-process and shared initialization/training intervals are charged; baseline arms ran inside learned harness and do not get a fabricated standalone zero training allocation. Shared checkpoint generation is counted once per task/seed/mask, not once per dense/factorized channel.
accounting_policy.inference_channel_ablation: Dense and factorized share each task/seed/mask checkpoint and optimizer trajectory; no separate discrete training cost was measured.
accounting_policy.standalone_fixed_baseline: Not measured. Existing executable includes training and learned machinery; full21132-byte executable is charged, not an imaginary small fixed-code-only binary.
accounting_policy.codebooks: Fixed algorithms are in source/binary. No separately transmitted dictionary exists; this does not erase source, executable, config or checkpoint footprint.
accounting_policy.checkpoint: Actual persisted checkpoint384bytes, including320parameter bytes and64header/layout bytes as Wolfram-calculated. No optimizer-state binary assumed.
accounting_policy.payload: Actual byte lengths from all R records; correct/mismatch fixed,dense,factorized1byte, fulltext4ASCIIbytes, receiver-only0; omitted0. Never charge the32 CSV logging columns as transmitted payload.
accounting_policy.transport_header: No separately serialized transport header is observed in this carrier experiment; no invented8byte header. Real network framing remains NOT_MEASURED.
accounting_policy.proposal_boundary: Existing NL4 envelope1024header+32payload is separately owned by parent and NOT_RUN here; it must not be equated with this bare carrier cost.
accounting_policy.timing_overlap: Whole-process contains initialization/training, row encode/decode and other execution/I/O; do not add row times to whole-process as if disjoint. Other_whole_process is arithmetic residual, not measured isolated I/O time.
accounting_policy.encoder_interval: main.om starts before tencode and stops at mid timestamp.
accounting_policy.decoder_interval: main.om measures from mid through resetting NO canonical output and tdecode; not decoder call alone.
accounting_policy.development: Includes preserved failed compiler attempts and controls/mutants as measured disk footprints; no runtime duration was recorded for these.
accounting_policy.analysis_receipts: Metric query/response artifacts generated by this slice are not recursively included in original producer-campaign byte totals; analysis costs remain unmeasured.
accounting_policy.source_inventory: Source component sum and frozen concatenated source are alternative representations, not a claimed additive transmission protocol.
accounting_policy.retry: Frozen public inference loop has no retry; all original development failures are retained separately.
